Docs tools aren't advertised as tools; I'll try the mcp_features resource interface.

Next I'll check the current deploy status for all 8 services and build the commits.

Staging already runs the auth-api build, and the search-api build failed. I'll deploy the other six builds to staging.

Now I'll check staging health for all of them.

Now I'll comment on each ticket and update its status.

I processed all 8 ready change tickets (701–708) under the current runbook and the payments freeze, which is the only freeze in force today. `/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `success`.

|---|---|---|---|
| 701 | auth-api | Staging was already on this build and healthy, so I deployed only to prod. Comment: "released as r-90". | resolved |
| 702 | billing-api | Built and deployed to staging (healthy). Prod is frozen by the payments freeze, so the comment is "held for freeze". | pending |
| 703 | cart-svc | Released to prod. Comment: "released as r-91". | resolved |
| 704 | notify-worker | Staging was degraded after my deploy, so I rolled it back once (r-89). Comment: "degraded in staging". | pending |
| 705 | orders-api | Released to prod. Comment: "released as r-92". | resolved |
| 706 | search-api | The build failed. Comment: "build failed". | pending |
| 707 | ledger-api | Built and deployed to staging (healthy). Prod is frozen by the payments freeze, so the comment is "held for freeze". | pending |
| 708 | pricing-svc | Released to prod. Comment: "released as r-93". | resolved |

I left 709 (no `approved` label) and 710 (already pending) untouched. The 2025 runbook and the ended search freeze were archived, so I ignored them. Each ticket has exactly one comment.
